origin: Named after the ad line for the Roach Motel bug trap: roaches check in, but they don't check out. It's one of the types Harry Brignull described when he coined the term dark pattern in 2010.
whenToUse: You review subscription cancellation or account deletion flows.
You compare the number of steps to sign up and to cancel.
You draw the line for retention screens.
whenNotToUse: You'd accept cancellations only by phone or chat.
You'd hide the cancel button behind several steps.
You'd push offers again and again before letting people cancel.

alternatives.name: Forced Continuity
alternatives.reason: Flows where a trial turns into a paid plan.

accessibility: Make the cancel button findable the same way as other buttons.
Don't hide guidance in small, faint gray text.
State the remaining service period in words.
Report the cancellation result right away.
